title: Walmart’s Prime Day Alternative Deals Offer Up to 86% Off Bose, Sony, Tory Burch, Samsung and Other Top Brands
summary: Snag summer-ready deals across your favorite brands at Walmart's 'Deals & More' sale.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

It’s the summer of deals, and Walmart is getting in on the action with its annual “Deals & More” sale that from now until Sunday (June 28). The retailer offers competitive deals that are worth checking out.

As someone who has covered deals in the past few years during the biggest tentpole events like Prime Day and Cyber Week, I am constantly monitoring the best promotions and steepest deals for you.

In addition, Walmart is currently offering a 50% off subscription for Walmart+ memberships , which gives you unbeatable perks like early access to deals, free shipping with no minimum, fuel discounts, at-home returns and more. Meanwhile, you can choose between a six-month subscription to Peacock or Paramount+ to jump-start your summer entertainment too.

GET 50% WALMART+

Below, I’ve rounded up some of the best deals from home audio to festival-ready fashion and beauty that will get you covered on your summer parties, getaways, and music festivals with savings up to 50% off this week .

Best Audio and Entertainment Deals

WALMART'S DEALS & MORE

VIZIO 65-Inch Class Quantum Smart TV

$398 $498 20% off

Buy Now at Walmart

A great choice, this 4K TV can deliver Full HD picture quality from your console, equipped with Wi-Fi 6 that optimizes streaming and gaming performance for faster and stronger streams.

Samsung 55-inch Class M70HB Series TV 2026

$348 $448 22% off

You can snag this Samsung 55-Inch 4K TV for less than $350, it delivers crisp, clear and vibrant visuals, and even has sports mode for your soccer viewing this summer, or filmmaker mode for movie nights.

Ray-Ban Meta Gen 1 Wayfarer

$224 $299 25% off

Ray-Ban Meta Glasses can be great for music festivals where you need to be hands-free while moving with the beats and enjoying a cold one. And since you’re bringing sunglasses to the event anyway, this would just be a handy 2-in-1 option.

Bose QuietComfort Headphones

$179 $349 49% off

At almost 50% off, the Bose QuietComfort Headphones are a good steal. I never travel without them, as they come in handy during my subway commutes, or when I want focus time at the office.

Acer Chromebook 315 Laptop

$149 $182.74 18% off

Have you ever thought you could buy a laptop for under $150? Me neither. This impressive Acer Chromebook 315 runs on a fast processor, starts up in under 10 seconds, has up to 14 hours of battery life, and built-in Google apps so this moves with your fast-paced lifestyle.

JBL Flip 7

$94.95 $149.95 37% off

For your pool parties and outdoor entertaining this summer, the JBL Flip 7 is under $95 today. It’s water- and drop-proof, boasts up to 16 hours of playtime and AI sound boost to improve audio.

JBL Soundgear Clips

Clip-on earbuds are a great option if you like to listen to music or podcasts outdoors while still having situational awareness. JBL claims that these are precisely angled for minimal audio leakage and has a boosted bass performance that gives you that powerful sound even if it’s over the ear.

Sony WF-C510 Truly Wireless Earbuds

$48 $69.99 31% off

If you prefer earbuds over headphones, this pair of Sony WF-C510 can be your next go-to. It’s portable, has up to 11 hours of battery life, and ambient sound mode when you’re outdoors so you can still hear your surroundings.

JBL Go 4 Portable Bluetooth Speaker

$37.95 $49.95 24% off

I personally love using these speakers when I’m alone in my room and especially when I’m on trips. It’s ultra-portable, has up to 7 hours of battery life and an amazing sound quality for its size.

Best Festival-Ready Fashion Deals

Drawstring Wide Leg Trousers

$17.99 $49.99 64% off

Lightweight pants are a must in the summer, and this pair is versatile enough to take you from soundstages, the beach and all your travels in between.

Devil Wears Prada Scoop Collection Maxi Lace Skirt

$17 $34 50% off

Lace seems to be everywhere this summer, and a printed will add a bold statement to any of your festival looks. You can just pair this with a white tank and accessories and you have a stylish summery vibe.

Tie-Front Crochet Cardigan

$9.99 $18.50 46% off

A crochet cardigan adds more personality to your outfit and it doubles as a throw when it gets cooler at night.

Madden NYC Women's Western Mini Skirt

$7.78 $17.50 56% off

A simple denim mini skirt gets a western spin, and we know you already got those cowboy boots to match.

$57.93 $172 66% off

Tory Burch polarized sunglasses for less than $60 is a great steal. Oversized sunnies are back, and you’ll need a pair to protect your eyes while you are jamming with your favorite artists on stage.

Suede Cowboy Boots

$37.99 $57.99 34% off

Cowboy boots at a music festival? Groundbreaking. Brown suede boots are a classic, and this is a nice option if you prefer a little heel.

Square Toe Mid Calf Cowboy Boots

$41.99 $69.99 40% off

Another cowboy boot option that’s a square toe in a darker hue, with a cute pattern and subtle colored embroidery.

Madden NYC Gum Sole Lace-up Sneakers

$25.20 $36 30% off

Music festivals require so many steps to get around and for dancing, so you need a pair that will support you through it all. A low-profile, neutral sneaker is easy to style with any outfit this summer and beyond.

Amy and Annette 14K Gold-Plated Hoop Earrings

$12.99 $89.99 86% off

One of the steepest discounts I’ve seen so far on accessories at 86% off, these gold hoops are 14K gold-plated, looks chic, and can quickly elevate any outfit.

WHIPPY Metal Waist Chain Belt

$9.59 $11.99 20% off

Festival fits don’t have to break the bank, accessorizing can totally transform any look. A chain belt can carry any simple outfit, and it will look like you put more effort than you actually did.

Endorsed by Jeonghan from SEVENTEEN, this popular K-beauty cleansing balm is an affordable pick to start your double cleanse after a long day.

Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask

I always wake up with soft, supple lips whenever I use this lip mask the night before. This product has been internet-viral and approved by Hollywood A-listers and KPOP idols, like Kendall Jenner and Felix from Stray Kids.

XBOX Series X Gaming Console
